Born at Plymouth about 1627, son of the Mayflower passenger Francis Eaton, who died in 1633.
In 1635 the court, with his mother's consent, placed him with the widow Bridget Fuller to be kept at school two years,
the first mention of schooling in the Plymouth Colony records.
Married Sarah Hoskins in 1660; their children included William, Benjamin (1664) ,
Rebecca and Ebenezer. Probably a daughter of William Hoskins of Scituate and Plymouth.
